parameters.name: CasId
parameters.description: The SSL Certificates Service certificate ID. This parameter is required when CertType is set to cas.

parameters.name: CasRegion
parameters.description:
The region of the SSL Certificates Service certificate. This parameter is required when CertType is set to cas.
- For Chinese site accounts, set this parameter to cn-hangzhou.
- For International site accounts, set this parameter to ap-southeast-1.

parameters.name: CertType
parameters.description:
The certificate type. This parameter is required when SslFlag is set to on. Valid values:
- **free**: free certificate.
- **upload**: uploaded certificate.
- **cas**: SSL Certificates Service certificate.

parameters.name: Certificate
parameters.description: The certificate content. This parameter is required when CertType is set to upload.

parameters.name: PrivateKey
parameters.description: The certificate private key. This parameter is required when CertType is set to upload.

parameters.name: RecordId
parameters.description: The ID of the record to bind. You can call the [ListRecords](~~2850265~~) operation to obtain the record ID.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation to obtain the site ID.

parameters.name: SslFlag
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable SSL. Valid values:
- **on**: Enable SSL.
- **off**: Disable SSL.
